obligations.ask: Provide a written response about the estate matter

results.segment: A written response about the estate matter is required within 28 days of the date of this letter.
The estate matter is being checked by the department that holds it, and any correction is applied automatically within 30 days.
This part of the letter is sent for information only.
We wrote to your landlord on 2 March and they have 28 days to reply to us, not to you.
